text: Does anybody have a crate of glasses to lend on Saturday? Happy to collect and return them washed.

text: The popcorn worked. Second attempt. Nobody is going to believe the first one.

author: Nisa Gezer
text: New here — moved in June and I like cooking for more people than I know. Point me at something.

author: Nick Ulrich
text: Walked the same street four times this afternoon. Somebody moved the chair back.
